tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dang po rlabs chen byang chub thugs bskyed mthus// sa chen rgyal ba'i zhing kun rab g.yo zhing*// bkra shis dge legs 'od kyis gsal byas pas// rgyal ba'i sras po pad+ma dkar por 'dud// bar du rdzogs smin sbyang ba rgya mtsho'i sgo /ye shes ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyu rkyen ma lus kun// grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs la gus phyag 'tshal// tha ma rdo rje gdan gyi ri yi spor// byams pa'i mtshon chas bdud sde'i dpung bcom nas// shes bya'i sgrib pa ye shes chen pos spangs// zad dang mi skye brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// sa chen 'di na lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs// mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis kyi// rin chen gdugs dkar phyogs kyi gos bzhin khyab// bka' drin mtshungs med shākya'i rgyal por 'dud// de nas wa ra nā si'i gnas mchog tu// dam chos 'dul ba'i sgo 'phar dang por phyes// lha dang mi yi che dgu kun btud nas// 'dul ba'i bslab pa yang dag khrims su bzhes// srid pa gsum gyi mchod gnas bla med pa// bum pa bzang po lta bu spangs rtogs kyis// rgyud gtams dgra bcom 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis// nor 'dzin khyon 'di dge legs snang bas khyab// gang zhig 'khor ba'i rang bzhin me yi 'obs// yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs dpal// gang la ma chags mtha' gnyis las 'das lam// thub pa'i chos 'dul mdzod la su mi gus// thub pa dgyes pa'i spyod pa rmad byung ba// legs mdzad yang dag khrims kyis rgyud bsdam te// phun tshogs zhi ba'i dga' tshal la snyogs pa// gang zag 'phags pa'i rjes su su mi slob// gang la slob rnams rnam grol sar 'gro ba'i// yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur rin po che// mi zad 'phags pa'i mdzod khang dam pa'i chos// bstan pa'i snying po so sor thar pa yin// mgon po skyobs pa de yis yang dang yang*// 'di ni ston dang bstan pa gnyis yin zhes// bsngags pa'i gnas de chos 'dul rin po che// mi zad bdud rtsi'i mdzod las rjes gdams pa// bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gnas gsum la// 'di na sgo gsum rab tu rgyal ba'i sde// bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong bcu phrag gcig

/rab tu byung ba'i dge tshul bzhi dang bcas// 'di gnas thar ba'i lam las mi 'khyogs te// nyes spyod g.yang sa shugs kyis chod pa'i phyir// phun tshogs yon tan dga' tshal la 'gro bas// chos 'dul me tog bkod pa phreng ba zungs// srid na chos 'dul nyi ma nam gnas pa// de srid bstan pa'i snang ba stong pa min// gang zag thub rjes 'grong ba mang byon phyir// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dul ba kho na yin// drang srong tshul 'di mtshungs pa med pa ste// snga rabs gshegs pa'i mgon po bgrangs yas pas// seng ge'i sgra 'di slob ma'i dbus su bsgrags// bstan pa rin chen nyi ma 'di gsal byas// bzhugs pa 'byon 'gyur skyob pa du ma yis// dang po tshangs spyod yang dag tshul khrims blangs// phyi nas byang chub snying por gshegs 'gyur gyis// lam 'di mi brten 'tshang rgyar 'gyur ma lags// de slad gzhan phan sems kyis rjes bzung te// gzhi gsum bslab pa'i gnas la legs zhugs pa'i// legs byas dri med zla 'od snang ba 'dis// rgyal bstan 'dul ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// der 'dzin 'phags pa'i 'dus pa yongs 'phel zhing*// bkra shis snang bas sa gsum yongs khyab shog

/ces pa'ang lcags lug lor ljon pa lung du dbyar gnas dang po dbu 'dzug dus tshul shing shis brjod du 7shākya'i dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtshos spel ba dge legs 'phel// na mo shākya mu na ye/ yid can srog gis bsdus pa'i 'gro mang khams// snying rje lcags kyus drangs bas bdag bzung zhing*// rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod la ches dpa' zhing*// pad+ma dkar por bsngags pa khyed la 'dud// zhing 'di bdag gir bzhes nas ser skya'i grong*// rin chen bdun gyis snang bas mdzes byas nas// mtshan dpe lang tsho gsar pa'i dga' ston gyis// rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer bltams la 'dud// ma rungs bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs ster nas// byang chub chen po'i go 'phang mngon byas pa// srid pa gsum na 'gran zla ma mchis pa// mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po khyed la 'dud// seng ge lta bu'i 'khor lo gsum gyis gtams// rgyun chad med pa'i gsung gis byed las kyis// rigs gsum 'phags pas srid 'dir bsod nams kyis// yon gnas dam pas gtams la gus pas 'dud// mgon po khyod kyis bcas pa'i mtshams nyid la// skye dga'i gtso bos 'da' bar mi spobs pa// sems rta 'dul ba'i gzhi gsum phyag bzhes gyis// bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i dbyar gnas pa'i// 'phags tshogs 'dus pa'i rten mchog dge slong grangs// skye dgu'i grangs dang btsun pa'i dge tshul zung*// bshad sgrub gnyis kyis bya bas dus 'das zhing*// rnam dkar dge ba'i phung po nyi gzhon gyis// snang bas sa gsum 'gro ba yid kyi khams// mi shes mun pa'i phung po yongs bcom zhing*// sa bcu lam lnga'i sbyang ba mthar phyin nas// rnam mkhyen go 'phang brnyes pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// gnas skabs phan bde'i snang ba'i dpal chen pos// srid 'dir rgyu ba'i tshogs rnams legs srung zhing*// mi mthun nyes pa'i phyogs rnams yongs bcom pa'i// bkra shis sa gsum snang bas rtag khyab shog

/maṅga laṃ/ ༈ oṃ swa sti/ thog mar snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis// yid can mtha' dag brtse bas bdag bzung zhing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin pa// mnyam med shākya'i gtso bo de la 'dud// sems rtog g.yo ba gdul bar dka' ba 'di// mthun pa'i gzer rnon so sor thar ba'i mdo// bslab gsum dmigs 'byed 'dul lung sde bzhi po// lung rtogs dam pa'i chos la gus pas 'dud// rgyal ba mnyam med de yis bcas pa'i khrims// rnam dag bslab pas rang gi rgyud gtams zhing*// lha mi'i mchod sdong 'dul 'dzin 'phags pa'i tshogs// rim byon brgyud pa rnams la phyag 'tshal te// bstan pa'i gzhi ma bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mi// bslab pa'i sdom pa chu yi chu lon bzhin// sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang po thob pa'i dus// phra bar btsal te rags par brjod par bya// de yang stod 'grel bas sogs brjod nas// yon tan gzhi rten 'phags pa'i tshul khrims te// dran shes bag yod gsum gyi skya bar nas// nyes byas phra mo tsam gyis ma gos pa'i// dal ba'i rten bzang don dang ldan par mdzod/// /
